title: An Agentic Just-in-Time Adaptive Intervention System for Personalized Sleep Support: Proof-of-Concept Study with N of 1 Data
abstract: arXiv:2609.21805v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Background: Just-in-time adaptive interventions (JITAIs) can use behavioral data to adapt support to changing contexts, but many rely on predefined rules and manual configuration.   Objective: We developed a proof-of-concept sleep JITAI using an AI agent to review personal data, evaluate reminders, adapt interventions, and record decisions for human review.   Methods: Running in Home Assistant on a configurable schedule, the agent follows a reusable skill file to review 30 days of sleep and behavioral data, including physical activity, smartphone use, and bedtime routines, to identify patterns and create or update automated reminders.   Results: Initial runs demonstrated technical feasibility, successfully completing data review and intervention decisions while limiting reminders to three per day and saving decision records. translated_title: 一种用于个性化睡眠支持的智能体即时自适应干预系统：基于单被试数据的可行性验证研究
translated_abstract: 背景：即时自适应干预（JITAIs）能够利用行为数据来适应不断变化的情境并提供支持，但许多此类干预依赖于预定义的规则和手动配置。目的：我们开发了一个概念验证型的睡眠即时自适应干预系统，利用AI智能体来审查个人数据、评估提醒、调整干预措施，并记录决策以供人工审查。方法：该智能体在Home Assistant中按可配置的时间表运行，遵循一个可复用的技能文件，审查30天的睡眠和行为数据（包括身体活动、智能手机使用和就寝习惯），以识别行为模式并创建或更新自动提醒。结果：初步运行证明了技术可行性，成功完成了数据审查和干预决策，同时将提醒限制在每天三次，并保存了决策记录。结论：智能体AI或可实现灵活、自适应的睡眠即时自适应干预，该架构支持未来的对比研究。
tldr: 该研究提出了一个基于AI智能体的睡眠即时自适应干预系统概念验证，智能体能够自动审查个人睡眠与行为数据、动态创建和调整干预提醒并记录决策供人工审查，展示了智能体AI在实现灵活、个性化睡眠支持方面的技术可行性。
en_tdlr: This proof-of-concept study demonstrates that an AI agent can autonomously review 30 days of personal sleep and behavioral data, dynamically create and adapt intervention reminders, and record decisions for human review, showing the technical feasibility of agentic AI for flexible, personalized sleep JITAI support.
